name: PHP Hooks SDK
description: Laravel and PHP SDK for building Claude Code hooks with Artisan commands and service providers
content:
#!/bin/bash
# PHP/Laravel hooks SDK runner
# Install: composer require beyondcode/claude-code-hooks-sdk
HOOKS_DIR="$HOME/.claude/phphooks"
if [[ -d "$HOOKS_DIR" ]] && command -v php &>/dev/null; then
  php "$HOOKS_DIR/run.php" --event "$HOOK_EVENT" --tool "$TOOL_NAME" 2>/dev/null
fi
exit 0
